# paperclip_company (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Paperclip company by `id` or by `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look a company up by name ...
data "paperclip_company" "studio" {
  name = "Greenlight Studio"
}

# ... or by identifier.
data "paperclip_company" "by_id" {
  id = "3f0e4a52-6c1b-4f0e-9a43-0d1e6f5a7b21"
}

output "studio_issue_prefix" {
  value = data.paperclip_company.studio.issue_prefix
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the company. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Exact name of the company. The lookup fails when several companies share the name.

### Read-Only

- `budget_monthly_cents` (Number) Monthly spending limit for the whole company, in cents. `0` means no limit.
- `description` (String) What the company does.
- `issue_prefix` (String) Prefix used for the identifiers of the company's tasks.
- `require_board_approval_for_new_agents` (Boolean) Whether new agents need board approval before they exist.
- `spent_monthly_cents` (Number) Amount spent in the current month, in cents.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status of the company: `active`, `paused` or `archived`.
